 Order

The petitioners, have challenged FIR No. 40/2021 for offences under Sections 498A,
323 of IPC registered with Police Station, Sogam, Kupwara as also the charge sheet emanating there from, which is stated to be pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Sogam Kupwara.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners and respondent No. 3/the complainant have entered into compromise in terms whereof respondent No. 3 has undertaken not to pursue the criminal case against the petitioner.
To support this Page |2 contention, the petitioner has placed on record a copy of the compromise deed dated 26.05.2025.
Mr. Faheem Nisar, learned GA enters appearance and accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 1.
Notice be sent to respondent No. 2 through concerned Police Station.
Learned counsel for the petitioner shall furnish a copy of the petition to Mr. Faheem Nisar, learned GA who may file his response by next date of hearing.

Petitioner and respondent No. 3 shall appear before this Court on Shaheen Ahmad Dar And Ors vs Union Territory Of J&K &Ors on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46529019/
